REGIONAL ECONOMICS | G3-G6 | Geography and measurement
|
|-- Merchant location -[mech]-> geographic revenue assignment
|   |-- [R] Revenue is assigned by merchant location.
|   `-- [I] This does not measure buyer location or export intensity.
|
|-- FY2025 revenue growth: computed from supplied filing rows
|   |-- [R] EMEA: 1,707 -> 2,426; +42.1%; increase 719.
|   |-- [R] APAC: 885 -> 1,128; +27.5%; increase 243.
|   |-- [R] Latin America: 97 -> 104; +7.2%; increase 7.
|   |-- [R] EMEA share of these increases: 719 / 969 = 74.2%.
|   `-- [R] NA growth +27.6% (seed-only); APAC roughly matches it.
|
|-- Revenue mix: useful anchors, incomplete pinned tables
|   |-- [R] Outside NA: 25.5% 2019; 28.6% 2021 (seed-only).
|   |-- [R] Outside NA: 28.7% 2023; 31.7% 2025 (seed-only).
|   `-- [I] Missing total/US rows prevent recomputing these shares.
|
|-- Europe GMV: nominal / constant-currency growth
|   |-- [S] Q2 2025: 49% / 42%; Q4 2025: 45% / 35%.
|   |-- [S] Q1 2026: 48% / 35%.
|   |-- [S] Q3 2026 constant currency: Europe 33%; NA 28%.
|   `-- [I] FX magnifies growth; the latest Europe lead survives FX.
|
`-- Contribution is not growth rate
    |-- [S] Outside NA: ~half of Q3 2025 GMV dollar growth, FX-neutral.
    |-- [S] Q1 2026 revenue: NA +33%, Europe +42%, APAC +30%.
    `-- [X] Aggregate international strength means every region leads.
